name: holoim-workspace
description: HoloIM monorepo containing capture, viewer-api, and viewer-web apps

scripts.dev:viewer: pnpm exec concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @holoim/api dev" "pnpm --filter @holoim/web dev"
scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently -n viewer,capture -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:viewer" "pnpm run dev:capture"
scripts.check:all: pnpm run lint:all && pnpm run typecheck:all
scripts.test:unit:viewer: pnpm --filter @holoim/contracts test && pnpm --filter @holoim/api test && pnpm --filter @holoim/web test
scripts.test:viewer: pnpm --filter @holoim/contracts test && pnpm --filter @holoim/api test && pnpm --filter @holoim/web test
scripts.test:xr:all: pnpm run test:xr:capture && pnpm run test:xr:viewer
scripts.verify:repo:viewer: pnpm --filter @holoim/contracts verify:fast && pnpm --filter @holoim/api verify:fast && pnpm --filter @holoim/web verify:fast
scripts.verify:workspace: pnpm run check:all && pnpm run test:unit:all
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run doctor && pnpm run verify:workspace
scripts.verify:pr: pnpm run doctor && pnpm run check:all && pnpm run test:unit:all && pnpm run build:all && pnpm run test:smoke:pipeline && pnpm run test:xr:smoke
